title: Chemistry-audit validation on the known Level A/B pKa plans
note: Deterministic re-scoring of archived plans; no model call. The superseded plans requested CPCM(Water) in the method string and used frequency jobs, so the solvation and single-point checks are expected to pass on them.

plan.user_text:
Calculate the pKa of chlorofluoroacetic acid (CHClFCOOH) using B3LYP/6-31G* with CPCM(Water) implicit solvation. To calibrate the systematic error, also compute Gibbs free energies for three reference carboxylic acids (and their conjugate bases) at the same level.

Step 1 — load 4 neutral acids by name (charge=0, mult=1):
  ha_acetic (acetic acid), ha_fluoroacetic (fluoroacetic acid), ha_chloroacetic (chloroacetic acid), ha_clfa (chlorofluoroacetic acid).

Step 2 — derive conjugate base geometries using structure_add_remove_proton (action='remove', auto=True) on each neutral acid. Use output_id:
  a_acetic (from ha_acetic), a_fluoroacetate (from ha_fluoroacetic), a_chloroacetate (from ha_chloroacetic), a_clfa (from ha_clfa).
Each output has charge=-1, mult=1.

Step 3 — run geometry optimisation + frequency job for all 8 species in parallel. Use method="B3LYP CPCM(Water)", basis="6-31G*", use_ri=False for ALL jobs. CRITICAL: do NOT use a 'template' or 'compounds' block — write every node explicitly as an individual entry in the nodes list. Use the geometry from the proton-removal step for each anion node.

Store Gibbs free energies as: G_ha_acetic_eh, G_a_acetic_eh, G_ha_fluoroacetic_eh, G_a_fluoroacetate_eh, G_ha_chloroacetic_eh, G_a_chloroacetate_eh, G_ha_clfa_eh, G_a_clfa_eh.

After all 8 freq jobs complete, add ONE LLM node (id: calibrate_pka) that:
  (a) Uses G_H_plus_ref_eh from settings and the 8 G values above.
  (b) Computes raw pKa for each reference acid: pKa = (G_A + G_H_plus_ref - G_HA) * 627.509 / 1.3644.
  (c) Derives correction delta_i = pKa_exp_i - pKa_raw_i for each reference acid (acetic=4.76, fluoroacetic=2.586, chloroacetic=2.86).
  (d) Applies delta_i to pKa_raw(CHClFCOOH) and reports their average as pka_clfa_calibrated.
Settings: G_H_plus_ref_eh = -0.01372
plan.name: Calibrated aqueous pKa of chlorofluoroacetic acid via B3LYP/6-31G* CPCM(Water)

nodes.prompt: Using settings.G_H_plus_ref_eh and artifacts G_ha_acetic_eh, G_a_acetic_eh, G_ha_fluoroacetic_eh, G_a_fluoroacetate_eh, G_ha_chloroacetic_eh, G_a_chloroacetate_eh, G_ha_clfa_eh, G_a_clfa_eh: compute raw pKa for each reference acid i via pKa_raw_i = (G_A_i + G_H_plus_ref_eh - G_HA_i) * 627.509 / 1.3644. Use experimental pKa values: acetic=4.76, fluoroacetic=2.586, chloroacetic=2.86. Compute delta_i = pKa_exp_i - pKa_raw_i. Compute pKa_raw_clfa analogously from G_a_clfa_eh, G_ha_clfa_eh. Compute corrected values pKa_clfa_i = pKa_raw_clfa + delta_i for i in {acetic, fluoroacetic, chloroacetic}. Report pka_clfa_calibrated as the arithmetic mean of {pKa_clfa_i}. Return JSON: {status, pka}.

Step 1 — load 4 neutral acids by name (charge=0, mult=1):

  a_acetic (from ha_acetic), a_fluoroacetate (from ha_fluoroacetic), a_chloroacetate (from ha_chloroacetic), a_clfa (from ha_clfa).
Each output has charge=-1, mult=1.

Step 3 — run geometry optimisation + frequency job for all 8 species in parallel. Use method="PBE0 CPCM(Water)", basis="def2-TZVP", use_ri=False for ALL jobs. Do NOT use a template loop — list each as an individual node pair. Use the geometry from the proton-removal step for each anion node.

Store Gibbs free energies as: G_ha_acetic_eh, G_a_acetic_eh, G_ha_fluoroacetic_eh, G_a_fluoroacetate_eh, G_ha_chloroacetic_eh, G_a_chloroacetate_eh, G_ha_clfa_eh, G_a_clfa_eh.

After all 8 freq jobs complete, add ONE LLM node (id: calibrate_pka) that:
  (a) Uses G_H_plus_ref_eh from settings and the 8 G values above.
  (b) Computes raw pKa for each reference acid: pKa = (G_A + G_H_plus_ref - G_HA) * 627.509 / 1.3644.
  (c) Derives correction delta_i = pKa_exp_i - pKa_raw_i for each reference acid (acetic=4.76, fluoroacetic=2.586, chloroacetic=2.86).
  (d) Applies delta_i to pKa_raw(CHClFCOOH) and reports their average as pka_clfa_calibrated.
Settings: G_H_plus_ref_eh = -0.01372
plan.name: Calibrated aqueous pKa of chlorofluoroacetic acid (CPCM water, PBE0/def2-TZVP)

nodes.prompt: Using settings.G_H_plus_ref_eh and the 8 Gibbs free energies in Hartree, compute raw pKa for each acid using the USER-SPECIFIED formula: pKa_raw = (G_A + G_H_plus_ref_eh - G_HA) * 627.509 / 1.3644. References: acetic (exp=4.76), fluoroacetic (exp=2.586), chloroacetic (exp=2.86). Compute deltas: delta_i = pKa_exp_i - pKa_raw_i for i in {acetic, fluoroacetic, chloroacetic}. Compute pKa_raw_clfa for chlorofluoroacetic acid the same way. Apply each delta_i to clfa: pKa_clfa_i = pKa_raw_clfa + delta_i. Take the arithmetic mean across the three corrected values to yield pka_clfa_calibrated. Return JSON: {status, pka}.

After all 8 freq jobs complete, add ONE kind:"tool" node

G_H_plus_ref_eh; the tool selects the correct proton reference itself.
